```{r}
read_fasta_df <- function (file = "") {
  fasta <- readLines(file)
  ind <- grep(">", fasta)
  s <- data.frame(ind = ind, from = ind + 1, to = c((ind - 1)[-1], length(fasta)))
  seqs <- rep(NA, length(ind))
  for (i in 1:length(ind)) {
    seqs[i] <- paste(fasta[s$from[i]:s$to[i]], collapse = "")
  }
  tib <- tibble(name = gsub(">", "", fasta[ind]), sequence = seqs)
  return(tib)
}

write_fasta_df <- function (data, filename) 
{
    fastaLines = c()
    for (rowNum in 1:nrow(data)) {
        fastaLines = c(fastaLines, as.character(paste(">", 
            data[rowNum, "label"], sep = "")))
        fastaLines = c(fastaLines, as.character(data[rowNum, 
            "sequence"]))
    }
    fileConn <- file(filename)
    writeLines(fastaLines, fileConn)
    close(fileConn)
}

dna_to_DNAbin <- function (dna){
  DNAbin <- as_DNAbin(dna)
  names(DNAbin) <- names(dna)
  return(DNAbin)
}
dna_to_DNAStringset <- function(x) 
{
    bioseq:::check_dna(x)
    DNAstr <- DNAStringSet(paste(x))
    names(DNAstr) <- names(x)
    return(DNAstr)
}

DNAStringSet_to_dna <- function(x){
    x_dna <- as_dna(paste(x))
    names(x_dna) <- names(x)
    res <- tibble(label = names(x), sequence = x_dna)
    return(res)
}

# Convert DNAstringset to DNAbin
DNAStringSet_to_DNAbin <- function(DNAStringSet){
  DNAbin <- as.DNAbin(DNAStringSet)
  return(DNAbin)
}
```

```{r}
merged_data <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:length(rd)){
  
  seq_path <- paste0(rd[i], "/post_med_seqs/")
  seq_file <- list.files(seq_path, pattern = "seqs.absolute.abund_and_meta.txt", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  seqs <- read_tsv(seq_file) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(sample_name)))
  
  seqs_long <- seqs %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name, sample_type, host_genus,	host_species,	collection_latitude, collection_longitude, collection_date, collection_depth:last_col()) %>% # Select sample_names and the each column contain sequence count data
  pivot_longer(-sample_name:-collection_depth) %>% # make into long dataframe
  filter(value > 0) %>% # Remove zero values
  filter(!(is.na(sample_name)))
  
  fasta_file <- list.files(paste0(rd[i], "/post_med_seqs/"), pattern = ".fasta", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)  
  fasta <- read_fasta_df(fasta_file)
  
  seqs_long <- seqs_long %>% left_join(., fasta)

  merged_data <- rbind(merged_data, seqs_long)
}

  distinct(name, sequence) %>%
  group_by(sequence) %>%
  summarise(duplicates = paste0(name, collapse = '-')) %>%
  separate(duplicates, into = c("A", "B"), sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(final_name = case_when(is.na(B) ~ A,
                                !is.na(as.numeric(str_sub(A, 1, 1))) & is.na(B) ~ A,
                                !is.na(as.numeric(str_sub(A, 1, 1))) ~ B, TRUE ~ A)) %>%
  select(sequence, final_name)

merged_data_clean <- merged_data %>%
  left_join(., name_update) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  dplyr::rename(name = final_name)
```

```{r}
summary <- merged_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(sample_name, "Ca1|Ca2|Ca3|C1-49|SCF049")) %>%
  mutate(culture = case_when(
    str_detect(sample_name, "Ca1|Ca2|Ca3") ~ "C. proliferum",
    str_detect(sample_name, "SCF049") ~ "C. occultum",
    TRUE ~ "SCF049-J"
  )) %>%
  group_by(culture, sample_name) %>%
  mutate(value_rel = value / sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(culture, name) %>%  # Calculate mean/sd across all sample_name
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value_rel, na.rm = TRUE),  # Compute standard deviation properly
    .groups = "drop"
  )


summary <- summary %>%
  filter(!str_detect(culture, "SCF049-J"))

summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean)) %>%
  filter(row_number() <= n() - 9) %>%
  mutate(name = fct_inorder(as.factor(name))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = mean, fill = culture)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                width = 0.2, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  facet_wrap(~ culture, ncol = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "DIV") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("SCF049vs055_DIVs.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("SCF049vs055_DIVs.svg", width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r}

filtered_mixed <- plot %>% #when adding together the two df exclude duplicate samples
   filter(!sample_name %in% clado_refs$sample_name)


###### merging clado_refs, which is the one of 055 and 049 to the one coming from filtering symportal retaining both 055 and 049

mixed55 <- rbind(clado_refs, filtered_mixed %>% select(sample_name, name, value, sequence, host_genus))

#use mixed55 as input for mixed filtering
#use plot as input for high filtering
#use all_data3 as input for medium filtering
#use all_data as input for low filtering

fasta_data <- paste0(">", mixed55$name, "\n", mixed55$sequence)

writeLines(fasta_data, "output.fasta") 

fasta_poci <- read_fasta_df("output.fasta") %>%
  deframe() %>%
  as_dna()
  
kdist_poci <- fasta_poci %>%
  dna_to_DNAbin() %>%
  kdistance(k = 6, residues = "DNA", method = "edgar") %>%
  as.matrix()

k_tree_poci <- kdist_poci %>% phangorn::upgma()

seqs_wide_poci <- mixed55 %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_name, "S8-")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name, name, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

k_unidist_poci <- GUniFrac(seqs_wide_poci, k_tree_poci)   #GUniFrac calculates all the distances 
k_unidist_poci <- k_unidist_poci$unifracs

du_poci <- k_unidist_poci[, , "d_0.5"]    # GUniFrac with alpha 0.5 
dist_poci <- as.dist(du_poci, diag = FALSE)

# Cluster the samples
hclust_samps_poci <- upgma(du_poci)

# Make the sample tree
tree_poci <- ggtree(hclust_samps_poci, size = 0.3) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.3, 
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)  # Remove margins
  )

# Get a sample order from ggtree
poci_sample_order <- tree_poci$data %>% 
  filter(isTip == "TRUE") %>%
  arrange(y) %>%
  pull(label)
  

pocimat <- all_data %>% filter(sample_name %in% tree_poci$data$label) %>%
  select(sample_name, RFLP = host_genus) %>%
  mutate(RFLP = case_when(RFLP == "acropora" ~ "Acropora", TRUE ~ RFLP)) %>%
  mutate(sample_name = make.unique(as.character(sample_name))) %>%  
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

poci_tree_mat <- gheatmap(tree_poci, pocimat, colnames = T, width=0.5)
poci_tree_mat <- gheatmap(tree_poci, pocimat, colnames = FALSE, width = 0.1, offset = 0) +
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20", na.value = "grey90") +
  layout_dendrogram() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
poci_tree_mat

rel_data <- mixed55 %>%
   group_by(sample_name) %>%
   mutate(value_rel = value/sum(value)) 

# Start plotting the composition data
plot_df_poci <- rel_data %>%
  mutate(sample_name = fct_relevel(sample_name, poci_sample_order)) %>% 
  filter(sample_name %in% poci_sample_order)

theme_set(theme_bw())

rel_data <- all_data %>%
   group_by(sample_name) %>%
   mutate(value_rel = value/sum(value)) 

# find the likely distinguishing seqs in here
test_df <- rel_data %>%
   group_by(name) %>%
   summarise(mean = mean(value_rel), n = n()) %>%
   arrange(desc(n), desc(mean))
```

#GUnifrac distance PCA

```{r}
dist_matrix_poci <- as.matrix(dist_poci)
samples_to_exclude <- c("S4-19NBOb", "1000-AGb_077","S4-43BNMb2", "S4-27NBOb2")
seqs_wide_poci_filtered <- seqs_wide_poci[!rownames(seqs_wide_poci) %in% samples_to_exclude, ]
dist_matrix_filtered <- dist_matrix_poci[!rownames(dist_matrix_poci) %in% samples_to_exclude, ] 


pca_result <- prcomp(dist_matrix_filtered)

# Get the scores of the principal components
pca_scores <- pca_result$x
sample_names <- rownames(dist_matrix_filtered)
# Plot PCA
p4 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(pca_scores), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label=sample_names)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 1) +
  geom_text(size = 3, hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.2) +
  labs(title = "PCA of GUnifrac Distance Matrix",
       x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("GUnifrac_distance_PCA.pdf", plot = p4, device = "pdf", height = 40, width = 40)


cmd_result <- cmdscale(dist_matrix_filtered, k = 2)  # 2D representation

# Convert to dataframe
cmd_df <- as.data.frame(cmd_result)
colnames(cmd_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")  # Rename dimensions
cmd_df$sample_name <- rownames(cmd_result) 

# Plot with 95% confidence ellipses

p5 <- ggplot(cmd_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 1) +
  geom_text(size = 3, hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.2) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +  # 95% confidence ellipse
  labs(title = "PCoA of GUnifrac Distance Matrix",
       x = "Axis 1",
       y = "Axis 2") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("PCoA_names.pdf", plot = p5, device = "pdf", height = 40, width = 40)

```

# Retrieve genetic similarity to 49 and 55 based on unifrac distances (not manually)
#calculate genetic distance from UPGMA tree

```{r}

# Calculate genetic distance (distance on the tree) of each sample from 49 and 55. Do proportion and differentiate 49 samples, 55 samples and mixed samples based on a treshold.

phylo_tree <- as.phylo(hclust_samps_poci)


# Find the node where Sample_A and Sample_B are located
node49 <- which(phylo_tree$tip.label == "C1-49-1_18S")
node55 <- which(phylo_tree$tip.label == "Ca1")

distance_matrix_nodes <- dist.nodes(phylo_tree)

get_dist_to_node <- function(tip_indices, node_indices) {
  # Get the distances from the tip indices to the node indices
  dist_to_node <- distance_matrix_nodes[tip_indices, node_indices]
  return(dist_to_node)
}

dist_to_49 <- get_dist_to_node(which(phylo_tree$tip.label %in% phylo_tree$tip.label), node49)
dist_to_55 <- get_dist_to_node(which(phylo_tree$tip.label %in% phylo_tree$tip.label), node55)


# Calculate a similarity ratio for each sample
similarity_ratio <- dist_to_49 / (dist_to_49 + dist_to_55)

# Create a data frame with similarity scores
similarity_df <- data.frame(sample = phylo_tree$tip.label, 
                            dist_to_49 = dist_to_49, 
                            dist_to_55 = dist_to_55, 
                            similarity_ratio = similarity_ratio)

colors_dist <- ifelse(similarity_df$similarity_ratio <= 0.4, "blue", 
                 ifelse(similarity_df$similarity_ratio >= 0.6, "red", "green"))

# Plot the tree with colors representing similarity
plot.phylo(hclust_samps_poci, type = "unrooted", tip.color = colors, main = "UPGMA Tree with Technical Replicates")


```

# Retrieve ecological information from dendrogram samples

```{r}
indexes <- unique(mixed55$sample_name)

ecology <- reference_data_clean2 %>% 
  filter(index_name %in% indexes) %>% 
  distinct(index_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

#merge similarity data but exclude 49 and 55 samples first
exclude_samples <- c("C1-49-1_18S", "C1-49-2_18S", "C1-49-3_18S", "Ca1", "Ca2", "Ca3")

# Exclude these samples from similarity_df
similarity_df_filtered <- similarity_df %>%
  filter(!sample %in% exclude_samples)

ecology <- ecology %>%
  left_join(similarity_df_filtered, by = c("index_name" = "sample"))

# Assign species based on similarity_ratio
ecology$species <- ifelse(ecology$similarity_ratio >= 0.55, "C. proliferum", 
                          ifelse(ecology$similarity_ratio <= 0.45, "C. occultum", "Intermediate"))

# remove acquaria data
filtered_meta <- ecology %>%
  filter(collection_longitude != 999, collection_latitude != 999)

proportions <- filtered_meta %>%
  group_by(collection_longitude, collection_latitude, species) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(collection_longitude, collection_latitude) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))

proportions_wide <- proportions %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = proportion,
    values_fill = 0  # Fill missing species with 0 proportion
  )

world_map <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_map, 
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), 
    fill = "lightblue", color = "white"
  ) +
  # Add pie charts
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = proportions_wide,
    aes(x = collection_longitude, y = collection_latitude),
    cols = c("C. occultum", "C. proliferum", "Intermediate"),
    pie_scale = 0.5  # Adjust pie chart size
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("C. occultum" = "red", "C. proliferum" = "blue", "Intermediate" = "grey"), 
    name = "Species"
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),  # Increase legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),  # Increase legend title size
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm")  # Increase legend key size
  )

ggsave("SCF049_ecological_map.pdf", width = 20, height = 10)



library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

         collection_latitude >= 20 & collection_latitude <= 30) 

p_persian <- ggplot() +
```

```{r}


library(ggforce)
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_scores$sample_name <- sample_names 
pca_scores <- left_join(pca_scores, ecology %>%
                          select(index_name, species), by = c("sample_name" = "index_name"))

pca_scores <- pca_scores %>%
  mutate(sample_name = case_when(
    sample_name %in% c("C1-49-1_18S", "C1-49-2_18S", "C1-49-3_18S") ~ "SCF049",
    sample_name %in% c("Ca1", "Ca2", "Ca3") ~ "SCF055",
    TRUE ~ sample_name  # Keep original species name if not listed
  ))

pca_scores$species[pca_scores$sample_name %in% c("SCF049")] <- "C. occultum"
pca_scores$species[pca_scores$sample_name %in% c("SCF055")] <- "C. proliferum"


# Plot PCA with influence zones
centroids <- pca_scores %>%
  filter(grepl("SCF049", sample_name) | grepl("SCF055", sample_name)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), label = species, .groups = "drop")


pc_variance <- pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2) * 100  # Percentage of variance for each PC

pc1_percentage <- round(pc_variance[1], 1)
pc2_percentage <- round(pc_variance[2], 1)


# Create the plot
p4 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = species, label = sample_name)) +
  geom_point(data = pca_scores %>% filter(grepl("SCF049", sample_name)), 
             size = 3, shape = 17, alpha = 0.7, aes(shape = "SCF049")) +  # Triangle for SCF049
  geom_point(data = pca_scores %>% filter(grepl("SCF055", sample_name)), 
             size = 3, shape = 15, alpha = 0.7, aes(shape = "SCF055")) +  # Square for SCF055
  geom_point(data = pca_scores %>% filter(!grepl("SCF049", sample_name) & !grepl("SCF055", sample_name)),
             size = 3, shape = 16, alpha = 0.7) +  # Default circle for others
  scale_color_manual(values = c("C. proliferum" = "#E74C3C", "C. occultum" = "#3498DB", "Intermediate" = "black")) +  # Elegant color palette
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("SCF049" = 17, "SCF055" = 15)) +  # Assign shapes for SCF049 and SCF055
  labs(title = "",
       x = paste0("(PC1) ", pc1_percentage, "%"),
       y = paste0("(PC2) ", pc2_percentage, "%")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +  # Clean theme with larger text for readability
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  # Bold and centered title
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),  # Bold axis titles
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),  # Axis labels with readable font size  
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),  # Reduce width of x-axis text
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),  # Reduce width of y-axis text
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),  # Larger legend text
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey", size = 0.5),  # Add grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey", size = 0.2, linetype = "dashed"),  # Optional minor grid lines
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10),
    legend.title = element_blank()  # Adjust margins for spacing
  ) +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Sample Group", override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    color = guide_legend(title = "Species", override.aes = list(size = 3))
  )
ggsave("PCA_GUnifrac_Professional.pdf", plot = p4, device = "pdf", height = 8, width = 10)







permanova_result <- adonis2(dist_matrix_poci ~ species, data = pca_scores, permutations = 999)

dispersion <- betadisper(dist(dist_matrix_poci), pca_scores$species)
permutest(dispersion, permutations = 999)
TukeyHSD(dispersion)

plot(dispersion)
```
